notes.title: New Enemy: Furious Erinyes!
notes.notes:
Heroes and believers!

Update bear here to present a new enemy type we've been developing for some time: the Erinyes, the chthonic deities of vengeance and our first modeled long-range enemies!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699752/4a3b541d0013e9b2ff2b6386e31216267f0f58b8.png[/img]
Erinyes are the daughters of the Dark itself, primordial entities that go after those who have taken false oaths or have broken them. And they are after our hero.

What oath has Asterion broken? What crime has he committed?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699752/ef9883582434119eee6feb32ce29f78c81933940.png[/img]

He hope you like our take on the Erinyes. They are usually represented as winged women or bird-women, sometimes clad in armor. But we went more for a reaper-esque aesthetic to make them something else, transform their function a tiny bit



Stay tuned for more!

Update bear, out!

notes.title: New Promo Video + Lore + Friends!
notes.notes:
Hello friends, heroes and believers!

Update bear here.

1. So we broke USD 2K! It has been a little slow coming, but there is plenty of time (31 days to go). 

2. We made a new promotional video you might have caught a glimpse of in social media. It's a 15 seconds long little trailer, hope you guys enjoy it:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DRo63MASFWI

3. LORE UPDATE!

Woop - Woop!

Here is a glimpse into the prehistory and set-up of our story: the ancient, timeless past of our world. 


 Asterion doesn't start right away, but this is sort of the state the world is in at the time of our hero's story. 

We'll go more in depth about the particulars of how we came up with our version of mythology in a later update, so stay tuned if you are a lore-buff.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699752/89db958fe12cf30fcabce9171fe065d78275933c.png[/img]

4. We'll have some Concept Art to share SOON, so keep even more tune to our channel.

Update bear, out.

notes.title: Things we are working on
notes.notes:
Hello true heroes and believers!  

We wanted to share with you some of the work we are currently doing.  

First off, here is a concept art for Icarus, the 3rd Warden: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699752/e6d311a4e76681d96ba43f95709390a6f6f3831e.jpg[/img]

Originally, we had thought of a more "mainstream" representation of Icarus. But we soon realized that... it was just a guy with some wings and too reminiscent of angels for our liking. So, we went back to the drawing board and tried to make him (or it?) more monstrous. More intimidating.
